d:
The Thunder defeated the Grizzlies, 128-97 tonight in Memphis. Ajay Mitchell contributed a team-high 35 points to go with 5 assists and 4 three pointers, with Shai Gilgeous-Alexander of the Thunder adding an additional 28 points (11-22 FG, 3-5 3P) in the game. Ty Jerome finished with a team-high 21 points along with 5 assists for the Grizzlies in the losing effort. The Thunder improve their record to 7-2 with the win, while the Grizzlies fall to 6-3 for the season.
